scope: Isolated native font-backend feasibility prototype; ordinary read-only review, no production integration or approval
result: No concrete defect found in the reviewed finite two-font/integer-placement scope.

candidate.production_binding: All35 copied production source/module members independently matched live accepted bytes before and after. Initial/full copy pins are in private evidence.

analysis.ownership: One cohesive textMasks owner is justified: native atlas renderRuns, compositing, sampling and manifest publication cannot reasonably supply TrueType shaping/hinting by enhancement. Direct C APIs introduce no extra C function. One face and optional shaper are reused across a batch; output remains plain owned Gray masks/bearings/26.6 advances for existing composition.
analysis.pointer_lifetimes: Font bytes copied into C memory outlive the face. Deferred cleanup order is shaper,face,font bytes,library. Pinned Raqm source copies UCS4 synchronously in raqm_set_text; temporary Go rune storage is not retained. Raqm glyph arrays are borrowed and consumed before next clear; FreeType slot bitmap storage is consumed before next glyph load. Each returned mask owns independent Go bytes. Signed pitch follows original source traversal.
analysis.bounds_and_errors: Font/size/labels/runes/glyphs/per-mask/aggregate pixel bounds precede respective retained allocations; error returns discard partial results and deferred resources release. Load/GetGlyph failures are checked; each temporary FT_Glyph is destroyed. Reviewed64-bit positional accumulators remain bounded by glyph count and32-bit advances/offsets. Non-gray bitmap modes refuse rather than silently invent conversion.
analysis.text_semantics: Primary FreeType/Raqm/Pillow sources corroborate BASIC rounded-pixel kerning quirk,unhinted RAQM metrics versus hinted masks,ascender bearing,pen-inclusive bounds,two rendered passes,rounding and overlapping gray alpha-over. Existing compositor/resampler remain unchanged. Multiline split/line-step placement is orchestration outside textMasks.

limits: Integer-position masks only;14 original fractional-start vectors remain explicitly unclaimed.
